profile.name: Prathmesh Dubey
profile.title: AI/ML Engineer  |  Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.tagline: I build AI-powered, production-grade web apps — wiring Large Language Models into real product workflows on a solid Java, Spring Boot, Python and React foundation.

summary: Software engineer with hands-on experience shipping AI-powered, production-grade web applications. Specialize in integrating Large Language Models (OpenAI, DeepSeek) into real product workflows, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agent design, on a strong full-stack base of Java, Spring Boot, Python, React and Next.js. Own features end to end, from REST API and data modeling to responsive UI.

items: Large Language Model (LLM) API Integration (OpenAI, DeepSeek)

bullets: Build and ship production features across Spring Boot back-end services and React/Next.js front-ends, owning assigned modules from requirement to release.
Design and implement secure REST APIs with authentication, validation and error handling, documented for other developers to integrate against.
Integrate LLM APIs into product workflows and iterate on prompt design to improve the accuracy and consistency of generated output.
Optimize MySQL and MongoDB schemas and queries and debug production issues, working in an Agile team with Git-based branching and peer code review.

projects.name: MedSyncAI
projects.subtitle: AI-Assisted Healthcare Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack clinic platform that centralizes patient records, prescriptions and daily operations, with a DeepSeek-powered assistant grounded in the clinic's own data.
bullets: Engineered a full-stack platform centralizing patient records, prescriptions and daily clinic operations, with role-based access separating doctor, staff and patient views of sensitive medical data.

Integrated a DeepSeek-powered assistant answering clinical and administrative queries in real time, using prompt templates and context injection to keep responses grounded in the clinic's own records.

projects.name: AI-Powered Code Review Assistant
projects.subtitle: Developer Tooling
projects.summary: An LLM-driven reviewer that reads GitHub pull requests and posts line-anchored comments on bugs, anti-patterns and style issues.
bullets: Built an LLM-driven tool that analyzes GitHub pull requests and auto-posts review comments flagging bugs, anti-patterns and style violations, cutting manual review effort for small teams.
Engineered the prompt pipeline converting raw diffs into line-anchored feedback, plus GitHub OAuth and webhook listeners for secure, event-driven PR processing.

projects.name: Smart Recipe Generator
projects.subtitle: Generative AI Web App
projects.summary: Turns whatever ingredients you have into a complete recipe with step-by-step instructions and prep-time estimates.
bullets: Developed a generative-AI web app turning free-text ingredient input into complete recipes with step-by-step instructions and prep-time estimates.
Designed structured prompts with output validation, served through a responsive React interface with loading and error states around the API calls.
